units.source_text: 不知不觉之间，天色已经向晓。

en.t: Before they knew it, the sky was already turning toward dawn.

units.source_text: 随从人等亦已起身，相与共话。

en.t: The attendants had also risen and were talking among themselves.

units.source_text: 马嘶之声也听到了。

en.t: The sound of horses neighing could be heard as well.

units.source_text: 薰君想起了别人告诉他的有关旅宿的种种情状，颇感兴趣。

en.t: Kaoru remembered the various things people had told him about lodging on a journey, and found them quite interesting.

units.source_text: 他把映着晨光的纸门推开，和大女公子二人共同欣赏天空的美景。

en.t: He slid open the paper door bright with morning light, and together with the elder princess admired the beauty of the sky.

units.source_text: 大女公子也稍稍膝行而出。

en.t: The elder princess also edged forward a little on her knees.

units.source_text: 这屋子不甚深，檐前相去甚近，从这里可以看到羊齿植物上闪闪发光的朝露。

en.t: The room was not very deep, and the eaves were quite close; from there they could see the morning dew glittering on the ferns.

units.source_text: 两人互相看看，姿态都很艳丽。

en.t: The two looked at one another, and both appeared wonderfully graceful.

units.source_text: 薰君说道：“我别无所求，但得如此与你相处，同心欣赏春花秋月，共话人世无常之状，于愿足矣。”

en.t: Kaoru said, "I ask for nothing else. If only I may be with you like this, sharing the sight of spring blossoms and the autumn moon and speaking together of the impermanence of this world, my wish will be fulfilled."

units.source_text: 他说时态度非常驯良，故大女公子的恐惧之心也渐渐消减，答道：“最好不要如此直接对面。

en.t: His manner as he spoke was so gentle that the elder princess's fear gradually lessened, and she answered, "It would be better not to sit face to face so directly like this.

units.source_text: 如果隔着一个帷屏，那么真个可以更加心无隔阂地谈话了。”

en.t: If there were a curtain screen between us, then we truly could talk more freely and without reserve."

units.source_text: 天色渐明，听见近处群鸟出巢奋翅之声，山寺晨钟之声也隐约地响出。

en.t: The sky grew gradually brighter, and nearby they heard flocks of birds leaving their nests and beating their wings; the morning bell of a mountain temple also sounded faintly.

units.source_text: 大女公子觉得同这男子如此同居一室，非常可耻，便劝道：“此刻你总好回去了。

en.t: The elder princess felt deeply ashamed to be in the same room with this man in such a way, and urged him, "Surely it would be best for you to go back now.

units.source_text: 教人见了实在难看。”

en.t: It would look truly improper if anyone saw us."

units.source_text: 薰君答道：“冒着朝露回去，好像真有其事，反而不好，外人还会猜度我们有何关系呢。

en.t: Kaoru replied, "If I go home through the morning dew, it will look as though something really did happen, which would be worse; outsiders would only wonder what sort of relationship we have.

units.source_text: 其实，我们外表可以装作寻常夫妇模样，而内里和他们不同。

en.t: In truth, outwardly we may appear like an ordinary husband and wife, while inwardly we are different from them.

units.source_text: 自今以后，一直保持清白的友谊。

en.t: From now on, let us always preserve a pure friendship.

units.source_text: 请你相信我决没有非礼之心。

en.t: Please believe that I have absolutely no improper intentions.

units.source_text: 你倘不体谅我如此忠贞不拔之志，那真是太无情了。”

en.t: If you do not understand this steadfast and loyal resolve of mine, that would be truly heartless."

units.source_text: 他并没有告辞的意思。

en.t: He showed no intention of taking his leave.

units.source_text: 大女公子觉得只管如此坐着，样子实在难看，心中焦灼，便对他说：“以后一定照你所说，但今早请你遵从我的要求。”

en.t: The elder princess felt that simply sitting there like this looked terribly improper, and, growing anxious, she said to him, "In the future I will certainly do as you say, but this morning please follow my request."

units.source_text: 她的样子非常狼狈。

en.t: She looked extremely flustered.

units.source_text: 薰君答道：“唉，真痛苦啊！

en.t: Kaoru answered, "Ah, how painful this is!

units.source_text: 破晓的别离啊！

en.t: A parting at daybreak!

units.source_text: 我真是‘从来不作凌晨别，出户彷徨路途迷’了！”

en.t: I am truly like the poem: 'Never having parted at dawn before, I step outside and wander, lost upon the road'!"

units.source_text: 说罢频频叹息。

en.t: Having said this, he sighed again and again.

units.source_text: 此时隐约听到某处鸡鸣之声，使他想起京中之事，便吟诗曰：

en.t: At that moment, he faintly heard a rooster crowing somewhere, which made him remember things in the capital, and he recited a poem:
